changelog:
Initial release: turns any agent into an expert, brand-neutral monitor buying consultant.

- Interviews users about use case, desk setup, hardware, and environment to determine exact recommended monitor specs.
- Provides clear, structured recommendations for panel type, resolution, refresh rate, ports, and ergonomic features.
- Avoids brand or model endorsements; focuses on empowering users to make unbiased purchase decisions.
- Suggests real monitors that match the confirmed specs at the end of the consultation.
